title: Production Payment Gateways Hardening, Branded Checkout Flow & Automated Tax Invoicing
objective: Harden bKash, SSLCommerz/Nagad, and Stripe payment services for production release with robust error handling, honest credential disclosures, brand-aligned checkout UI, automated durable subscription state hydration, and official downloadable payment tax receipts/invoices.
in_scope: Harden backend payment services (server/services/bKashService.ts, server/services/sslCommerzService.ts, server/services/stripePaymentService.ts) with strict idempotency, resilient error boundaries, and zero fake timeouts

Harmonize CheckoutModal and PaymentMethodModal to adhere strictly to the Nihomi brand palette (Obsidian #0A0A12, Crimson #E45147, Amber #F59E0B) with transparent staging vs production credential indicators
Implement automated post-payment invoice and tax receipt generation in downloadable A4 PDF format (including transaction ID, VAT/Tax registration, Nihomi official logo, and student billing details)
Ensure database subscription hydration persists immediately upon payment verification with instant tier elevation across Student and Founder views
Create automated test suite (scripts/test-production-payments-and-invoicing.ts) verifying checkout initialization, callback validation, receipt generation, and subscription tier persistence
Integrate GATE-09-PRODUCTION-PAYMENTS into the pre-flight release gate and verify via real browser flow
out_of_scope: Physical point-of-sale card terminals in brick-and-mortar Japanese schools
Manual paper ledger book tax audits
acceptance_criteria: Payment gateways operate in strict production candidate mode with zero mock functions or fake timeouts
Checkout modal renders seamlessly in Obsidian, Crimson, and Amber brand palette across mobile and desktop
Successful checkout updates user subscription tier in database without requiring server restart
Learners can download an official Nihomi-branded Payment Invoice & Tax Receipt in A4 PDF format
risks: Payment provider API downtime or missing production environment secrets. Mitigation: Graceful fallback with transparent guidance to learner, preserving state.
